@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+name: px1 agentic PR review
+description: An AI reviewer that investigates a pull request with read-only tools and comments only on findings it verified.
+author: px1
+
+inputs:
+  model:
+    description: OpenAI model, for example gpt-6-luna.
+    required: true
+  price-input:
+    description: Model input price in USD per million tokens. The cost cap is only as accurate as the prices you give.
+    required: true
+  price-output:
+    description: Model output price in USD per million tokens.
+    required: true
+  price-cached-input:
+    description: Cached input price in USD per million tokens (default same as input).
+    required: false
+    default: ''
+  max-cost:
+    description: Hard cost cap in USD per run.
+    required: false
+    default: '0.50'
+  exclude-globs:
+    description: Optional newline-separated globs never shown to the model. Exclusion is not redaction.
+    required: false
+    default: ''
+  post:
+    description: Post findings to the pull request (true) or only write them to the job summary (false).
+    required: false
+    default: 'true'
+
+runs:
+  using: composite
+  steps:
+    - name: Set up Go
+      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
+      with:
+        go-version-file: ${{ github.action_path }}/../go.mod
+        cache: false
+
+    - name: Review the pull request
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        PX1_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
+        PX1_PRICE_IN: ${{ inputs.price-input }}
+        PX1_PRICE_OUT: ${{ inputs.price-output }}
+        PX1_PRICE_CACHED: ${{ inputs.price-cached-input }}
+        PX1_MAX_COST: ${{ inputs.max-cost }}
+        PX1_EXCLUDES: ${{ inputs.exclude-globs }}
+        PX1_POST: ${{ inputs.post }}
+        PX1_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        PX1_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+        PX1_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+        PX1_PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
+        PX1_PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
+        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        if [[ -z "$PX1_PR" ]]; then
+          echo "px1: this action runs on pull_request events" >&2
+          exit 2
+        fi
+        if [[ -z "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
+          echo "px1: set OPENAI_API_KEY from a repository secret in the step's env" >&2
+          exit 2
+        fi
+        bin="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/px1"
+        (cd "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/.." && go build -o "$bin" .)
+        out="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/px1-agentic"
+        args=(agentic-review --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --base "$PX1_BASE" --head "$PX1_HEAD" --out "$out"
+          --model "$PX1_MODEL" --price-input "$PX1_PRICE_IN" --price-output "$PX1_PRICE_OUT"
+          --max-cost "$PX1_MAX_COST" --title "$PX1_PR_TITLE" --body "$PX1_PR_BODY" --transcripts=false --yes)
+        if [[ -n "$PX1_PRICE_CACHED" ]]; then args+=(--price-cached-input "$PX1_PRICE_CACHED"); fi
+        while IFS= read -r pattern || [[ -n "$pattern" ]]; do
+          [[ -z "$pattern" ]] || args+=(--exclude-glob "$pattern")
+        done <<< "$PX1_EXCLUDES"
+        echo "::warning title=px1 model transfer::This sends the pull-request diff, and files the model chooses to read, to OpenAI. Exclusion globs are not redaction."
+        "$bin" agentic-review "${args[@]:1}" | tee "$out.log"
+        if [[ "$PX1_POST" == "true" ]]; then
+          cost="$(grep -m1 '^Spent about' "$out.log" || true)"
+          "$bin" post-github --findings "$out/findings.json" --pr "$PX1_PR" --head "$PX1_HEAD" --footer "$cost"
+        fi
+        {
+          echo "### px1 review"
+          echo '```'
+          sed -n '/=== Result ===/,/^Report:/p' "$out.log" | sed '$d'
+          echo '```'
+        } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-/dev/null}"

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+# Agentic review in CI
+
+`px1 post-github` and `agentic-action/` run the agentic reviewer on every pull request and comment on the result, like a hosted reviewer, without a hosted service. Each repository carries a workflow; the key stays in that repository's secrets.
+
+## Set up a repository
+
+1. Copy `examples/px1-agentic-review.yml` to `.github/workflows/` in the repository.
+2. Add a repository secret `OPENAI_API_KEY` (Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions). Never put the key in the workflow file.
+3. While px1 is private, also add `PX1_TOOL_TOKEN`, a read-only token for the px1 repository, or make the action available to the repository under px1's Actions settings.
+4. Open a pull request.
+
+## What it posts
+
+- One **sticky summary comment**, found by a hidden marker and edited on every push instead of adding a new one. With no findings it says so, and that this is not evidence the change is correct.
+- **Inline comments** on the changed lines for findings that fall inside the diff, at most 20 per run. A finding already commented on an earlier push is not posted again.
+- Findings outside the diff stay in the summary, with their evidence.
+
+## Safety
+
+- Runs on `pull_request`, never `pull_request_target`. Pull requests from forks are skipped: they get no secrets and a read-only token.
+- The model reads the diff and any file it asks for at that commit through read-only git. Secret files and key-shaped values are blocked or redacted; this is detection, not access control.
+- `max-cost` is a hard per-run cap checked before every model call, using the prices you supply.
+- `continue-on-error: true` in the example keeps a failed or skipped review from blocking a merge.
+- The title and description of the pull request are passed as environment variables, never interpolated into a shell script.
+
+## Commands
+
+    px1 post-github --findings findings.json --pr 7 [--repo owner/name] [--head SHA] [--footer TEXT] [--dry-run]
+
+`GITHUB_TOKEN` is read from the environment only. The workflow needs `pull-requests: write`.
+
+## Known limits
+
+- Very large pull requests exceed the model budget and fail; there is no fallback yet.
+- A policy rejection from the model provider is not retried yet.

+# Copy to .github/workflows/px1-agentic-review.yml in the repository to review.
+# Needs a repository secret named OPENAI_API_KEY. Never put the key in this file.
+name: px1 review
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: write
+
+concurrency:
+  group: px1-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  review:
+    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    continue-on-error: true # a failed review must never block a merge
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: kedarvartak/px1
+          ref: master # pin to a commit SHA once you trust a version
+          path: .px1-tool
+          token: ${{ secrets.PX1_TOOL_TOKEN }} # only needed while px1 is private
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: ./.px1-tool/agentic-action
+        env:
+          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
+        with:
+          model: gpt-6-luna
+          price-input: '0.10'
+          price-output: '0.50'
+          price-cached-input: '0.01'
+          max-cost: '0.50'

blocks.title: Review changes
blocks.summary: 7 related files share the "review" change signal.

inspectionQuestions.observation: The implementation and a nearby companion test both changed in this diff.
inspectionQuestions.question: Which changed test demonstrates the new behavior, including its failure or boundary case?

explanations.title: Runs the reviewer and optionally publishes its findings
explanations.summary: The action runs the reviewer against the pull request’s base and head, using the configured model, prices, cost cap, and exclusions. It requires an OpenAI key; with `post: true` it publishes findings, while `post: false` leaves the result in the job summary.

explanations.title: Adds a non-blocking, same-repository PR review workflow
explanations.summary: After this workflow is added to a repository, it reviews non-draft pull requests from branches in that same repository on open, push, reopen, and ready-for-review events. Fork pull requests are skipped, and a newer run cancels an older one for the same pull request; review failures do not block merging.

explanations.title: Publishes inline findings and retains the rest in a summary
explanations.summary: The new command puts findings on changed lines into inline review comments, up to 20 per run. Other findings remain in the summary, and inline findings already posted on an earlier push are not posted again.

explanations.title: Keeps one summary comment and qualifies empty results
explanations.summary: The summary comment is identified by a marker and updated on later runs instead of duplicated. When there are no verified findings, it says so without implying the change is correct.

limits: Progress is stored only in this browser and is not shared with GitHub.

evidence.label: Deterministic analysis
evidence.detail: Rules, attention signals, and inspection questions were computed from this exact comparison. Zero findings means no matches, not that the change is safe.

evidence.label: AI findings
evidence.detail: No hosted AI finding set was attached.
limits: AI findings are proposals to inspect, not proof of correctness.

evidence.label: AI explanations
evidence.detail: 4 optional AI explanations attached for the exact report head; they may be incomplete or wrong.
